title: In 2006, a tiny deep-reef fish was pulled from deep water off South Australia and misidentified; nearly 20 years later, scientists recognised a new species
summary_full: A newly identified species of deep-reef fish, collected back in 2006, has intrigued scientists after spending nearly twenty years in a museum's vault due to a mix-up. A thorough re-examination unveiled unique physical traits that highlight the significance of museum collections in preserving and unveiling hidden biodiversity. This find serves as a reminder of the untapped potential awaiting discovery within scientific archives.
